IGUI_ALifeStanceDots_MapEnabled_tooltip: Stance icons on the world map and the minimap.
IGUI_ALifeStanceDots_MapStatuses: NPCs to show on the map
IGUI_ALifeStanceDots_MapStatuses_tooltip: Untick a status to hide those NPCs. Same colours as the markers over their heads. Singleplayer only: in multiplayer the server's settings decide.
IGUI_ALifeStanceDots_MapRange_tooltip: Only NPCs within this many tiles of you show on the map. The server may set a lower limit.
IGUI_ALifeStanceDots_MapLineOfSight_tool: Within range is not enough: you must also see them. Once out of sight they stay where you last saw them for the time below.
IGUI_ALifeStanceDots_MapMemory_tooltip: With 'Only NPCs you can see' on: how long an NPC stays on the map, at the spot you last saw them, after you lose sight of them.
IGUI_ALifeStanceDots_MapResidents_toolti: Your base's residents (Jeem, blue house) show at any distance. Multiplayer: their actual location only shows while they are within 250 tiles of you; further away they stay where they were last known.
IGUI_ALifeStanceDots_MapDeaths_tooltip: A light grey X on the map where one of your base's residents died, for this many minutes. 0 hides it.
IGUI_ALifeStanceDots_MapSize_tooltip: Multiplier for the world map icons; they already scale with screen resolution.
IGUI_ALifeStanceDots_MiniMapSize_tooltip: Multiplier for the minimap icons; lower it if they crowd the minimap.
